notes.title: Demo Update 13/6/2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update will include the following:

1. When HP is full, you will automatically pick up the fruit when you touch it; when you are not holding an item and approach a fruit, a pick-up tip will show up.  

2. Adjust the shooting position of Ethan.  

3. Adjust the hitbox activate time of the enemy's jump attack  

4. Adjust the shooting position of Goblin Chieftain.  

5. Adjust some death advices of Vedia.  

6. Adjust the note in Vedia's house to be easier to understand  

7. Rockfall Sword--Remove: speed-1   

8. Rockfall Slash--Power of the sword wave reduced, but rock summons even if the wave hits an obstacle /enemy  

9. Jumping Rod--Power of the shock wave increased  

Thank you for your support

notes.title: Demo Update 8/6/2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update will include the following:
[olist]
Most of enemies HP & attack will be nerfed.

Remove excess obstacles in the Forest.

Reduce amount of enemies.

Fix the weird settings for some traps.

Starting stage from checkpoint will start with full HP.
[/olist]
Sorry for unpleasant experience caused by the previous version. Thank you for playing the Demo version.

notes.title: "Herb Seek Slash" Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



《Herb Seek Slash》Demo version is now available! There are three main stages in the Demo version, it covers about 30% content of the full version.



Please feel free to try and give some suggestions, I will take reference and improve my game.



If you have played the Demo version before this announcement, there are some updates in the latest version:
[olist]
The beginning narrative is changed.

Change in the beginning flow: 

In the previous version, Ethan had to talk to Vedia before he could go out >>

This part is skipped in the latest version, will enter the Forest Stage just after the beginning narrative. (That's why the narrative is changed.)

Key remainder added to the weapon and held item UI in battle.

Damage text will pop up with larger size and then shrink.

"Gain Ability Points" notice displayed when first clearing a stage.

Change in fonts in most of the UIs, tutorials


[/olist]
Thank you for your support and patience.
